notes:
- Asset Manager: Task / Name switch (bottom left). Name view lists every asset A-Z, click one for its tasks, each with its own +
- Asset Manager: In Scene rows show just the asset name, with a Task dropdown next to Version (the task and its subtasks; swaps on Update)
- Asset Manager: published subtasks (e.g. horse · hat) show up and can be referenced or imported
- Asset Manager: cache rows show a 'Cache' tag in the Task slot
- Open / Save As: User column header is now a dropdown too: show one user's files only (stays picked as you click around)
- Save As: new Task dropdown next to the file name. Pick the task, an existing subtask, or New subtask... to save a variant under its own name and versions in the same task (e.g. horse_hat.v001.ma in Model)
- Save As remembers the last task/subtask saved for each asset/shot, and starts on the open file's subtask
- Subtask names: letters and numbers only, and can't be a task name
- Open / Save As: new Task column; click its header to show All, the task, or one subtask
- Works for shots too
- Referenced subtask files are recognised for caches, Texture Connect and cache links
